title: Aravaipa Running — Results 2026: Black Canyon
claims: Aravaipa's 2026 results summary lists 1,626 finishers for the Black Canyon weekend of 14 February 2026.
The summary gives the 100K winners as Hans Troyer 7:20:00, Jennifer Lichter 7:57:04 and nonbinary runner Sunny Tellwright 15:56:33.
The summary gives the 50K winners as Seth Ruhling 3:16:28, Jane Maus 3:47:03 and nonbinary runner Cal Calamia 4:18:57.
Aravaipa's 100K time for Lichter is one second faster than the 7:57:05 on UltraSignup and in RUN247.

verification.note: Aravaipa 官方 results-2026 页 Black Canyon 段：1,626 finishers、100K/50K winners；100K 765 + 50K 850 = 1,615，与 1,626 差 11，正文并列不强行闭合。
